reasons: The clause in § 7.2 unambiguously burdens Customer (we must disclose and match any more favourable third-party offer for Vendor), so the direction test in the rule is correctly applied — this is a reverse MFN, not a Vendor-granted MFN.
The redline implements the preferred position with the minimal necessary edit: full deletion of § 7.2, exactly as the redline guidance directs; no Vendor-granted MFN benefiting us is lost.

The comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural, correctly prefixed, states what changed and why, and correctly cites the supporting acknowledgement in § 12.3 that we made no most-favoured-customer commitment.
Deterministic check confirms the operation applies to p0026; the high change ratio is expected because the rule calls for deleting the obligation outright.
